name: Stu3dio
tagline: Make an AI film by talking to a director, a scriptwriter and a character artist inside a 3D studio.
problem: Generating a coherent AI video means juggling separate tools for plot, script, characters, images and clips, and one change upstream breaks everything downstream.
solution: Each film is a tree of nodes (logline, characters, objects, scenes, final film). Users walk a 3D studio and talk to AI roles that fill those nodes, scribble on images to edit them, and review a scene timeline before generating video. Editing a node marks its descendants stale so they regenerate with fresh context; every generation is a queued job with stored artifacts.
demo_moment: Team-described: brainstorm with the director, refine the script, scribble a costume change onto a character, then generate the stitched film.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Selected by the organizer as one of 12 finalists among 261 submissions.
Models the film as a dependency tree, so an edit regenerates only what it affects.
Turning a generation pipeline into a studio with staff to talk to makes an abstract workflow tangible.

lessons: A multi-step AI pipeline demos better as characters in a place than as a form with steps.
